name: Lively Galaxy
description: A livelier mid game: strong peaceful empires grow restless and pick fights, overlapping borders breed incidents, and small troop fleets may invade weakly held colonies.

flags.name: ambitionPressure
flags.label: Ambition pressure
flags.description: Empires with idle warships and long peace grow restless; restless AIs relax their war-review attitude threshold.

flags.name: borderFriction
flags.label: Border friction
flags.description: Empires whose territories overlap suffer yearly border incidents (mining disputes, blockades, station seizures) that sour relations and count toward war.

flags.name: smallerInvasions
flags.label: Smaller invasions
flags.description: Troop fleets smaller than the stock 10 ships may be sent against weakly held colonies (set the minimum-ships param above 0).

params.name: ambitionRise
params.label: Ambition gained per peaceful year (at the reference fleet size)

params.name: ambitionShipsRef
params.label: Idle warships for the full ambition rate

params.name: ambitionThreshold
params.label: Ambition at which an empire grows restless

params.name: ambitionWarFactor
params.label: War-review attitude relaxation per ambition point

params.name: frictionChance
params.label: Yearly incident chance at the reference overlap

params.name: frictionOverlapRef
params.label: Overlapping territory cells for the reference chance

params.name: frictionMaxChance
params.label: Cap on the yearly incident chance per pair

params.name: incidentRelationDrop
params.label: Relation drop per incident (victim's view; the aggressor's drops by half)

params.name: incidentWarFactor
params.label: War-review attitude relaxation per remembered incident

params.name: incidentMemoryDecay
params.label: Share of remembered incidents kept each year

params.name: invasionMinShips
params.label: Minimum troop-fleet ships against weak colonies (0 = stock 10)

params.name: invasionTroopRatio
params.label: Share of the required troop strength a small troop fleet must carry (stock 0.5)

params.name: invasionWeakTroops
params.label: Colony troop strength below which the smaller rule applies
